verdicts.reason: A keeps the earbud case as a strong hero centered under the logo, but the headline is undersized for the wider canvas, and there are large empty bands between the product, the copy and the Shop button, plus dead space below the CTA. B uses the same text and CTA layout but shrinks the product to a small icon, so the key image no longer matters. That leaves a big empty gap above the headline and makes the layout feel even more sparse and unbalanced.
